name: ExceptionReporterObject::WriteCallStack(CONTEXT*) (the report's call-stack section; thiscall ret 4; moved from ReportText)
notes: Hooked, not run in-game. 700 cases: the DbgHelp table in the image points at fakes (StackWalk with scripted frames, SymGetSymFromAddr, SymGetLineFromAddr, UnDecorateSymbolName), the imports GetCurrentProcess/GetCurrentThread/VirtualQuery/GetModuleFileNameA are faked (module lookup on a fake PE), the report file's Length (slot 7) and Write (16) record, source lines come from a real sandbox file (good and missing paths).
